content: Priya Raman (SRE lead) wants every triage to start with the exact rollback command, before any diagnosis.
The payments team (owner: Arjun Mehta, DBA) must be paged for anything touching payments-db or pgbouncer. Slack channel #payments-oncall.
checkout-api is deployed with Argo Rollouts. Rollback command: kubectl argo rollouts abort checkout-api -n shop && kubectl argo rollouts undo checkout-api -n shop.
Change freeze: no deploys to checkout-api or payments-db between 18:00 and 23:00 IST on sale days.
notifications-worker consumes topics otp-events (12 partitions) and receipt-events (12 partitions).
search-api feature flags are toggled with flagctl; the search team prefers flags over rollbacks because rollbacks take 12 minutes.
